international.title: Passing bill to speed up gas projects and datacenters would be ‘serious mistake’, Al Gore says
international.summary: Former vice-president at Cop31 urges lawmakers to rethink contentious bipartisan Baaja bill advanced by the US Senate It would be a “serious mistake” to pass a contentious bipartisan bill to speed up energy projects and datacenters that has divided Democrats and environmentalists, Al Gore said. The legislation, known as the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (Baaja), will make it easier to build large infrastructure projects in the US, from oil and gas pipelines and datacenters to crucial clean energy components such as solar and wind power and transmission lines, scaling back environmental protections and legal challenges in order to do so.
